raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "be the base salary of"
      role subject "a primary care physician at public hospitals"
      role object ?s1
      polarity affirmed
      at "2026"
    end
    match
      relation "be the base salary of"
      role subject "a judge at a court"
      role object ?s2
      polarity affirmed
      at "2026"
    end
  end
  compare ?s1 above ?s2
